level_flow_measured.1_tutorial: FIRST ever level only: a large hand points at a circle on the ice; tap (357,632)
level_flow_measured.2_cutscene: skip button ~(634,94); ~5-16 s; plays on the first level only
level_flow_measured.3_ready: countdown 3-2-1 over the fisherman; HUD 0M/100M appears
level_flow_measured.4_gameplay: a vertical line hangs from the rod; steer LEFT/RIGHT.  HUD: depth 0M/100M, fish n/11, shields n/2.  Unsteered, a level ended after ~4 s at 47-62 m
level_flow_measured.5_result: 本次收获 / 新纪录 / 下潜深度 NN米 / fish cards / 退出 + 冰钓礼券
level_flow_measured.6_popup: a 图鉴 popup can block afterwards: 恭喜您获得新图鉴 / 点击任意位置继续 -> tap anywhere

line.method: argmax of dark(<60) pixel count per column in water ROI (120,430)-(620,1180)
line.observed: line_x 350-352, dark count 126-600, runner-up column only 26 => 6-19x separation
line.validated: 18/18 real gameplay frames detected; 13/13 non-gameplay frames correctly refused

vision_measured.depth_proxy: hook_y, and the dark-pixel count which grows with depth — no per-frame OCR needed
vision_measured.fish_obstacles: warm-hue blobs in the water; below the hook = fish, above = ice scenery

control_measured.axis: horizontal only: line x is the control axis, y is fixed
control_measured.gain_evidence: finger 382->254 (128 px) moved the line 350->286 (64 px), read from pixels
control_measured.first_move_note: matches the PHASE 4 world-map finding: the client eats the first motion after touch_down

verifier_signals.CONTROL_SESSION_RAN: the servo sent at least one move
verifier_signals.RESULT_PAGE: 本次收获 or 下潜深度 present
verifier_signals.BAIT_DECREASED: home bait counter strictly lower after the run
verifier_signals.POINTS_INCREASED: 我的冰钓积分 increased (0 -> 190 observed)

policy.authority: FISHING TOURNAMENT — NORMAL BAIT MAX SCORE POLICY V2 (operator directive 2026-09-30)
policy.ONLY_NORMAL_BAIT: The sole resource this agent may spend on fishing is NORMAL_BAIT.
policy.USE_OWNED_ITEM: allowed for NORMAL_BAIT and for event-internal upgrade currency earned by normal fishing; treasure tickets are NO LONGER allowed even when already owned (V2 §4)
policy.SPECIAL_MODE: POLICY_DISABLED_BY_USER: special bait / Treasure Mode / Free Special Fishing / any special-mode attempt must not be used even when free
policy.SPECIAL_MODE_IS_NOT_A_GAP: This is a policy verdict, not a capability gap.  Nothing here is to be developed or reported as missing work.
policy.UPGRADE_FISHING_KIT: allowed, but only with free event-internal currency read LIVE as cost <= owned; gems / real money / purchased tokens are BLOCKED (V2 §5)
policy.not_verified: whether exiting mid-level refunds the bait — NOT verified, so NOT relied on
